notes.title: Share your feedback—Scarlett University Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you![/h2]

Hi friends! Firstly, for those who played the demo on Steam or Itch.io—a huge thank you! Your support really means a lot. Development is now well underway on the full story, and our team of artists are busy turning the lewd happenings at SU into a titillating reality. We also have some exciting news to share soon about the VA talent who will be voicing the characters—stay tuned.

If you have any particular feedback or suggestions for the game itself, the story, art, or writing, then we'd love to hear your opinion (good, bad, and the ugly) in order to make SU the best experience it can be.

Drop a comment, leave a review, or just DM BimboByte via [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/BimboByte/]Reddit[/url] or [url=https://x.com/BimboByte]X[/url].

Happy gaming!

BimboByte ❤

notes.title: Scarlett University Demo - Releasing March 4
notes.content:
[h1]THE BIG NEWS[/h1]
The Scarlett University free demo will be releasing on March 4 to coincide with Steam's Visual Novel Fest 2025!

You'll be immediately thrust (and I stress the word "thrust") into our heroine's third week at Scarlett University–starting with a fresh attempt at losing your (simulated) virginity. 😈 Meet your room mate and some of the other students as you find your way though four (of the nearly 50) sequential chapters. Just don't be surprised if things get lewd pretty quickly, you're at Scarlett University after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343195/c030f7149de4a4655061f295ca3f47fb867c74ea.jpg[/img]
[h2]BYO vibrator or sex toy of choice![/h2]
The best part is that if you have a [url=https://www.lovense.com/a/bimbobyte]Lovense[/url] toy, you'll be able to sync with the story and really bring the experience into a new dimension. All toys are supported!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343195/e52f3d3be90af7268809c105eb73bca18a7e39ed.jpg[/img]
We can't wait to see you around campus. ❤️
